svg.text: SaaS Support Case Workbench - sample run

g.text: PS C:\Users\User\Libraries\saas-support-case-workbench>
python app.py --case-id CASE-1001
Case: CASE-1001 - Training content fails to load
Product area: Content player
Symptom: Several learners see a temporary error when opening one course.
Customer impact: A group of learners cannot complete the assigned course.
Affected scope: Several learners in one customer account
Request ID: req-demo-a17
Observed HTTP status: 502
Reported recent change: The customer reports an integration update earlier today.
Starting assessment: Server or dependency error observed; the cause is not confirmed.
Suggested checks (verify before drawing conclusions):
- Correlate the request ID in authorized service logs.
- Check dependency health, latency, and nearby failures.
- Review recent changes and confirm recovery with a new request.
- Verify the reported recent change and its timing.
Draft engineering handoff:
CASE-1001 - Training content fails to load. Impact: A group of learners
cannot complete the assigned course. Observed: HTTP 502 for request
req-demo-a17. Please investigate the attached facts; root cause is not yet
confirmed.
